candidate_windows.window_text: The proposed CP-GPT has 24 decoder layers with 16 attention heads.The hidden dimension is 1024. In total, CP-GPT has 343M parameters.We train CP-GPT for 1O epochs on eight NVIDIA 3090 GPUs using DeepSpeed ZeRO-2, with a learning rate of $4 \times 1 0 ^ { - 6 }$ and a warm-up phase during the first $10 \%$ of training steps.
